tEn: NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026: Jensen Huang on the AI Industrial Revolution
tZh: NVIDIA GTC 柏林 2026：黄仁勋谈 AI 工业革命
sEn: Jensen Huang takes the GTC Berlin stage to frame AI as a five-layer manufacturing industry and a new industrial revolution built across Europe.
sZh: 黄仁勋登上 GTC 柏林舞台，将 AI 定义为五层结构的制造业与一场正在欧洲落地的新工业革命。

consensus.en: AI is a manufacturing industry producing tokens, a new industrial revolution like electricity.
consensus.zh: AI 是一个生产 token 的制造业，如同电力一样，是一场新的工业革命。

consensus.en: Europe can build a full-stack AI economy across energy, chips, models, agents, and applications.
consensus.zh: 欧洲可以构建覆盖能源、芯片、模型、智能体和应用的全栈 AI 经济。

consensus.en: Agents consist of model, harness, secure sandbox, knowledge, and tools; security is paramount.
consensus.zh: 智能体由模型、执行框架、安全沙箱、知识和工具五部分组成；安全至关重要。

consensus.en: Open models plus proprietary data and post-training can achieve frontier, sovereign intelligence.
consensus.zh: 开放模型加上专有数据和后训练，可以实现前沿的、主权级的智能。

consensus.en: Physical AI needs three computers: training, digital twin simulation, and robotics deployment.
consensus.zh: 具身 AI 需要三台计算机：训练、数字孪生仿真和机器人部署。

consensus.en: Extreme co-design across chips, software, and algorithms delivers million-fold AI performance gains.
consensus.zh: 跨芯片、软件和算法的极致协同设计，带来百万倍的 AI 性能提升。

contrarian.en: AI is not just software; it is infrastructure and factories, not merely a tool.
contrarian.zh: AI 不仅仅是软件；它是基础设施和工厂，而不仅仅是工具。

contrarian.en: AI will not end software or tools companies; it will create more users and turn them into AI companies.
contrarian.zh: AI 不会终结软件或工具公司；它将创造更多用户，并让它们成为 AI 公司。

contrarian.en: Moore's Law has largely ended; extreme co-design, not process scaling, drives progress now.
contrarian.zh: 摩尔定律已基本终结；如今推动进步的是极致协同设计，而非制程 Scaling。

contrarian.en: Humanoid robots, not specialized forms, will be the largest-volume robotics platform.
contrarian.zh: 人形机器人，而非专用形态，将成为出货量最大的机器人平台。

contrarian.en: Every telco base station will evolve into distributed AI infrastructure, not just connectivity.
contrarian.zh: 每个电信基站都将演变为分布式 AI 基础设施，而不仅仅是连接。

contrarian.en: Building agents is easy: ask an agent to build it for you, using open models and tools.
contrarian.zh: 构建智能体很简单：让一个智能体用开放模型和工具为你构建。

turns.en: Welcome to the stage, NVIDIA founder and CEO, Jensen Huang.
turns.zh: 欢迎 NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋上台。

turns.en: Hello, Berlin!
turns.zh: 你好，柏林！

turns.en: Welcome to GTC. It's great to be here. Before we start, let's give it up for our pre-game show hosts.
turns.zh: 欢迎来到 GTC。很高兴来到这里。在开始之前，让我们为我们的预热节目主持人鼓掌。

turns.en: Smart and adorable. They spoke about AI infrastructure, sovereign AI, AI safety, and physical AI. They covered an enormous amount of ground this morning, and we are going to take it one step further.
turns.zh: 聪明又可爱。他们谈到了 AI 基础设施、主权 AI、AI 安全和物理 AI。今天上午他们覆盖了大量内容，而我们将更进一步。

turns.en: It's really interesting what do L'Oreal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé, and HSBC have in common. Well, they're all European companies and they're all working with NVIDIA on AI. Everybody here is all activated on the AI ecosystem and working towards the AI economy.
turns.zh: 有趣的是，欧莱雅、Revolut、Spotify、默克、沃达丰、Zara、保时捷、雀巢和汇丰有什么共同点。嗯，它们都是欧洲公司，而且都在与 NVIDIA 合作开展 AI 业务。这里的每个人都在 AI 生态系统中活跃起来，并朝着 AI 经济迈进。

turns.en: We've been working here in Europe now for 33 years. You probably don't realize that NV1, NVIDIA's first chip, NV2, and NV3, which became Riva 128, the chip that saved our company, really, and launched our company, were all built in Europe. Our first partner was SGS Thompson. We manufactured a chip in Crolles, France, assembled it in Malta, and shipped it around the world.
turns.zh: 我们在欧洲已经工作了 33 年。你们可能没有意识到，NV1、NVIDIA 的第一款芯片 NV2 和 NV3，也就是后来成为 Riva 128 的芯片——这款芯片真正拯救了我们的公司并推动了公司的发展——都是在欧洲制造的。我们的第一个合作伙伴是 SGS Thompson。我们在法国 Crolles 制造了一款芯片，在马耳他组装，然后运往世界各地。

turns.en: Our first largest customer, the largest customer of GeForce days in the beginning, was a company called MediaMarkt. Do you know them? MediaMarkt had a spectacular idea about building PCs, as you remember, and they were our largest customer. It was Elsa, a German company, that brought NVIDIA into the workstation industry in the year 2000. Now, NVIDIA is in every single workstation all over Europe designing cars. Everything from styling, design, engineering, simulation, all the way through to even inside the car, which a European company brought us into, Audi, in the year 2005. Then in year 2020, we started working on autonomous vehicles with Mercedes.
turns.zh: 我们最早的 largest 客户，GeForce 早期最大的客户，是一家叫 MediaMarkt 的公司。你们知道他们吗？MediaMarkt 有一个关于组装 PC 的绝妙想法，你们记得的，他们是我们最大的客户。是 Elsa，一家德国公司，在 2000 年将 NVIDIA 带入了工作站行业。现在，NVIDIA 遍布欧洲的每一台工作站，用于设计汽车。从造型、设计、工程、模拟，一直到汽车内部，这是一家欧洲公司——奥迪在 2005 年将我们带入的。然后在 2020 年，我们开始与梅赛德斯合作开发自动驾驶汽车。

turns.en: As you could see, NVIDIA's life journey, the entire 33 years, I've spent a lot of time in Germany. So, I'm delighted to be back. Thank you.
turns.zh: 正如你们所见，NVIDIA 的发展历程，整整 33 年，我在德国度过了很多时间。所以，我很高兴回来。谢谢。

turns.en: I'm delighted to do GTC here. This year, this last year, we started the new journey to building a new industry here in Europe, the beginnings of the AI economy. In the last year alone, we've invested nearly 10 billion dollars in Europe across startups, big partnerships, small partnerships, all over Europe. This last week alone, as I journeyed from France and UK to Sweden and now here in Berlin, we announced the investments of 14 startup companies. Overall, since the beginning, we now have 12,000 plus partnerships across Europe. And we're all working towards one goal now.
turns.zh: 我很高兴在这里举办 GTC。今年，去年，我们开始了在欧洲建立新产业的新征程，这是 AI 经济的开端。仅在过去一年里，我们在欧洲投资了近 100 亿美元，涉及初创企业、大型合作伙伴、小型合作伙伴，遍布欧洲。仅上周，当我从法国和英国到瑞典，现在到柏林，我们宣布了对 14 家初创公司的投资。总的来说，从一开始，我们现在在欧洲有超过 12,000 个合作伙伴关系。我们现在都在朝着一个目标努力。

turns.en: After decades after decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution. This image was generated by computer. It was prompted by me. Nice simple prompt about AI powering a new industrial revolution generated this. I gave it a few partners that I wanted to highlight, companies that we're working with, and this is an extraordinary thing. In the mind of the AI, this is what it means to build a new industry, generation of tokens, the production of intelligence, which integrates into every single industry powering a new industrial revolution.
turns.zh: 经过计算机行业几十年的发展，我们现在正处于一场新工业革命的开端。这张图片是由计算机生成的。是我提示生成的。一个关于 AI 推动新工业革命的简单提示生成了这个。我给了它几个我想强调的合作伙伴，我们正在合作的公司，这是一件非凡的事情。在 AI 的思维中，这就是建立新产业的意义，生成 token，生产智能，并融入每一个行业，推动新工业革命。

turns.en: A new industrial revolution happens when the new technology affects how we build something and what we can build. How we build something and what we can build. I think in every single way, artificial intelligence will affect everything we build and in fact enable us to build new things. In this way, because everyone will use it, every company will be powered by it, because it's digital intelligence, the foundation of everything. Every single person will use it, every company will be powered by it, every industry will be transformed, and new ones will be created. In this way, like electricity, it is a new industrial revolution, and we're at the very beginnings of that.
turns.zh: 当新技术影响我们如何建造某物以及我们能建造什么时，新工业革命就会发生。我们如何建造以及我们能建造什么。我认为在各个方面，人工智能将影响我们建造的一切，并实际上使我们能够建造新事物。这样，因为每个人都会使用它，每家公司都将由它驱动，因为它是数字智能，是一切的基础。每个人都会使用它，每家公司都将由它驱动，每个行业都将被改变，新的行业将被创造。这样，就像电力一样，这是一场新工业革命，而我们正处于其开端。

transcript.sec: What is AI? The Five-Layer Cake

turns.en: The question is what is AI? And this is a big deal. If you want to be part of creating this future, understanding what is AI is vitally important. And this is really a simple framework. We were early to observe that in fact AI is a manufacturing industry. AI is not just software technology. It is software technology, but not just. AI of course runs on a computer, but the way that that computer operates is fundamentally different. Rather than a tool that's used by us, it is now part of a machinery, an infrastructure, factories that are producing intelligence that are integrated into every single industry and application.
turns.zh: 问题是 AI 是什么？这很重要。如果你想参与创造这个未来，理解 AI 是什么至关重要。这其实是一个简单的框架。我们很早就观察到，AI 实际上是一个制造业。AI 不仅仅是软件技术。它是软件技术，但不仅仅是。AI 当然运行在计算机上，但计算机的运行方式根本不同。它不再是我们使用的工具，而是机械的一部分，基础设施，生产智能的工厂，并融入每一个行业和应用。

turns.en: A simple model is to think about is think of AI as a five-layer cake. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory that generates tokens, digital intelligence from the models that run on it, that are integrated into every application. A five-layer cake. To be part of this AI economy, you don't want to just be consuming the AI, you want to be producing the AI. We could do all of that here in Europe. And in fact, we've already started.
turns.zh: 一个简单的模型是把 AI 想象成一个五层蛋糕。能源为先进计算机提供动力，这些计算机是 AI 工厂的一部分，生成 token，即数字智能，来自运行在其上的模型，并融入每一个应用。一个五层蛋糕。要成为这个 AI 经济的一部分，你不想只是消费 AI，你想生产 AI。我们可以在欧洲完成所有这些。事实上，我们已经开始了。

turns.en: Europe is building its AI economy. And it's five-layer cake represented here. We've got great partnerships, and when you look across this five-layer cake, you could recognize that in fact it is a new industry because there's growth at every single layer. We're creating jobs, creating growth at extraordinary rate. Companies here in Europe, Schneider, Siemens Electric, and Siemens Energy in doing incredibly well around the world. We're the computing layer. We integrate into AI factories that are now flourishing all over Europe. Startup companies like Nebius doing incredibly well. A new company called Firebird, which is setting up a new cloud in the Central Asia region. And even Cassava in Africa.
turns.zh: 欧洲正在建设其 AI 经济。这里展示的是五层蛋糕。我们有很好的合作伙伴关系，当你审视这个五层蛋糕时，你会认识到它确实是一个新产业，因为每一层都在增长。我们正在创造就业机会，以惊人的速度创造增长。欧洲的公司，施耐德、西门子电气和西门子能源在全球表现非常出色。我们是计算层。我们融入现在遍布欧洲的 AI 工厂。像 Nebius 这样的初创公司表现非常出色。一家名为 Firebird 的新公司正在中亚地区建立新的云。甚至非洲的 Cassava。

turns.en: Every single Telco in the future, and I predict this, every single Telco in the future, with 100,000 sites representing some 100 gigawatts of distributed Telco base stations and data centers will in the future evolve into a distributed AI network.
turns.zh: 未来每一家电信公司，我预测，未来每一家电信公司，拥有 10 万个站点，代表约 100 吉瓦的分布式电信基站和数据中心，未来将演变成分布式 AI 网络。

turns.en: So, the AI infrastructure layer is being built out. Which is then above that, the AI models. It's really important to recognize that long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist. Just as before you could have an internet, you have to have the networking. Just as before you could really enjoy the capabilities of electricity, you have to have electrified houses, electrified power plants. And so, the models are the next layer.
turns.zh: 所以，AI 基础设施层正在建设中。然后在其之上是 AI 模型。必须认识到，在 AI 模型出现之前很久，基础设施就必须存在。就像在拥有互联网之前，你必须先有网络。就像在真正享受电力带来的能力之前，你必须先有电气化的房屋、电气化的发电厂。因此，模型是下一层。

turns.en: It's also interesting to observe that the model layer is not just language models. It represents language, biology, chemicals, physics, robotic actions, animation. And it represents models of all sizes. These different industries are going to be powered by different modalities of AI models, which then integrate into the AI natives, the startups. And there are so many here in Europe. So, Europe's AI economy is starting, and it's really accelerating. It's great to see.
turns.zh: 同样有趣的是，模型层不仅仅是语言模型。它代表语言、生物学、化学、物理学、机器人动作、动画。它代表各种规模的模型。这些不同的行业将由不同模态的 AI 模型驱动，然后整合到 AI 原生公司、初创企业中。欧洲这里有很多这样的公司。所以，欧洲的 AI 经济正在起步，而且确实在加速。很高兴看到这一点。

turns.en: At the foundation of it, where we contribute, most people think is GPUs. It is true. We started in 1993 building a graphics chip, which emerged into the GPU, the programmable shading GPU. Over time, we added CUDA acceleration to that, reinvented computing as we know it, which then brought forth artificial intelligence. But, NVIDIA today is really a full stack, end-to-end, complete AI factory platform.
turns.zh: 在其基础层面，也就是我们贡献的地方，大多数人认为是 GPU。没错。我们 1993 年开始制造图形芯片，后来演变成 GPU，即可编程着色 GPU。随着时间的推移，我们为此添加了 CUDA 加速，重新发明了我们所知的計算，从而催生了人工智能。但今天的 NVIDIA 实际上是一个全栈、端到端、完整的 AI 工厂平台。

turns.en: The breadth of technology of our company over the years has really expanded. Everything from GPU computing, Vera Rubin is our latest generation, to the NVLink switches that connect them into one giant GPU, the Vera BlueField 4 compute that we recently introduced, and I'll say a few words about that later, to Spectrum-X, which is our Ethernet solution, making NVIDIA the largest networking company in the world today, to Grok 3, a decode accelerator for generation text for token generation, to Vera 4, Vera BlueField 4 storage acceleration, which I'll say a few words in that in just a second, and then Vera RTX compute, and I'll mention that in just a second. But, this now represents the breadth of technology necessary to create the AI factory.
turns.zh: 多年来，我们公司的技术广度确实扩大了。从 GPU 计算（Vera Rubin 是我们最新一代），到将它们连接成一个巨型 GPU 的 NVLink 交换机，到我们最近推出的 Vera BlueField 4 计算（我稍后会简单介绍），到 Spectrum-X，这是我们的以太网解决方案，使 NVIDIA 成为当今世界上最大的网络公司，到 Groq 3，用于生成文本、生成 token 的解码加速器，到 Vera 4，Vera BlueField 4 存储加速（我马上会简单介绍），然后是 Vera RTX 计算，我马上会提到。但这现在代表了创建 AI 工厂所需的技术广度。

turns.en: But, nothing works unless you have software that activates it all. The first part is the system software that runs the AI factory. These systems are gigantic. A 1 GW data center, 1 GW AI factory, costs about $50 billion land, power, shell, all of the compute, networking, storage, power, cooling, all connected together, multiple acres of AI factory. Just turning it on and operating it is a marvel in itself. The magnificent amount of software necessary to energize this factory, to put it to use and produce tokens is an extraordinary feat. Nvidia offers the entire full stack software.
turns.zh: 但除非你有软件来激活一切，否则什么都无法工作。第一部分是运行 AI 工厂的系统软件。这些系统非常庞大。一个 1 GW 的数据中心，1 GW 的 AI 工厂，成本约为 500 亿美元，包括土地、电力、外壳、所有计算、网络、存储、电源、冷却，全部连接在一起，占地数英亩的 AI 工厂。仅仅启动和运行它本身就是一项奇迹。为这个工厂供电、投入使用并生产 token 所需的大量软件是一项非凡的壮举。NVIDIA 提供整个全栈软件。

turns.en: On top of that are what we call the CUDA X libraries, the algorithms of our company. What Nvidia truly is is an algorithm company that designs silicon to accelerate them. Of course, one of them is cuDNN, what many researchers recognize as the library that brought forth that started the Big Bang of modern AI, cuDNN. It's cuDNN is to AI what SQL is to the world's database industry. It's a domain-specific language, a domain-specific library. Just as OpenGL and DirectX enabled real-time computer graphics, cuDNN enabled the AI computing industry. 350 other libraries, those libraries are in fact the crown jewels of our company. Everything from computational lithography to signal processing, image processing, data processing, particles, fluids, sparse solvers, incredible breadth of libraries that many of you in the audience have connected into your company. This is how we open new markets. This is how we connect Nvidia into algorithms that enable you to do computation at incredible speeds.
turns.zh: 在此基础上是我们所谓的 CUDA X 库，即我们公司的算法。NVIDIA 本质上是一家算法公司，设计硅芯片来加速这些算法。当然，其中之一是 cuDNN，许多研究人员认为这是引发现代 AI 大爆炸的库，cuDNN。cuDNN 之于 AI 就像 SQL 之于世界数据库行业。它是一种领域特定语言，一个领域特定库。就像 OpenGL 和 DirectX 实现了实时计算机图形一样，cuDNN 实现了 AI 计算行业。还有 350 个其他库，这些库实际上是我们公司的皇冠上的明珠。从计算光刻到信号处理、图像处理、数据处理、粒子、流体、稀疏求解器，令人难以置信的库广度，在座的许多人已经将这些库连接到你们的公司中。这就是我们开拓新市场的方式。这就是我们将 NVIDIA 连接到算法中的方式，使您能够以惊人的速度进行计算。

turns.en: And then finally, on the right-hand side, on that side, the models. This is the new software. The new engine of new applications. And it sits on top of and it collaborates with the CUDA X libraries. These models NVIDIA have been working on across multiple domains. With these models, it opens up new opportunities and I have lots to say about that later on.
turns.zh: 最后，在右侧，那边，是模型。这是新软件。新应用的新引擎。它位于 CUDA X 库之上并与之协作。NVIDIA 一直在多个领域研究这些模型。有了这些模型，它开辟了新的机会，我稍后会有很多要说的。

turns.en: Well, every single generation NVIDIA started with Pascal. The AI era started with the Pascal new what is called DGX-1 system. DGX-1 brought to the world the world's first AI supercomputer. I introduced it 10 years ago. Delivered the first one to Open AI. Started their computation journey. From Pascal to Volta to Ampere then to many of you who heard about us for the very first time, Hopper the current generation Blackwell and then now Vera Rubin in full production. Notice six generations of architectures. With each generation we advance the technology.
turns.zh: 嗯，NVIDIA 的每一代都从 Pascal 开始。AI 时代始于 Pascal 新的所谓 DGX-1 系统。DGX-1 为世界带来了世界上第一台 AI 超级计算机。我 10 年前介绍了它。将第一台交付给 Open AI。开始了他们的计算之旅。从 Pascal 到 Volta 到 Ampere，然后到你们中许多人第一次听说我们的 Hopper，当前一代 Blackwell，然后现在是全面生产的 Vera Rubin。注意六代架构。每一代我们都推进技术。

turns.en: In the course of that last 10 years, we've improved AI performance by 1 million times. If you would take a step back and think about what would Moore's Law have done in 10 years time it would have the first 5 years would have improved by factor of 10, the second 5 years by another factor of 10, a 100 X improvement in 10 years time. In the same period of time because of the way NVIDIA extreme co-designs we're innovating across every single computer, across every single stack of the software, optimizing new algorithms, creating new algorithms, while creating architectures to accelerate it, Working across that entire domain, what we call extreme co-design, where we're able to accelerate AI by a million times. And we're going to continue to do so. This is what Nvidia builds today. And this is the foundation by which we can enable Europe to be part of the AI ecosystem, the AI economy.
turns.zh: 在过去 10 年中，我们将 AI 性能提高了 100 万倍。如果你退一步想想摩尔定律在 10 年内会做什么，前 5 年将提高 10 倍，后 5 年再提高 10 倍，10 年内提高 100 倍。在同一时期，由于 NVIDIA 的极端协同设计方式，我们在每台计算机、每个软件栈上进行创新，优化新算法，创建新算法，同时创建架构来加速它，在整个领域工作，我们称之为极端协同设计，我们能够将 AI 加速 100 万倍。我们将继续这样做。这就是 NVIDIA 今天构建的。这就是我们能够使欧洲成为 AI 生态系统、AI 经济一部分的基础。

turns.en: Now, each generation in the beginning, Pascal was GPUs. Volta was GPUs. Ampere was GPUs. And Hopper was GPUs. We invented the new DGX form factor. Then it was Blackwell that introduced to the world the first rack-scale computing. And I'll show you that in just a moment. Rack-scale computing turned one entire system into one giant computer, one GPU. And now, with Vera Rubin, we're extending it to processing beyond models, beyond large language models, to now processing the entire agent. Now, we'll refer back to this slide later, but remember this. The agent has to think. And that's where the model comes in. Perception, reasoning, planning, and using tools. All of that runs on the large language model. And the models are designed to do that. But the agent also has what is called a harness. Basically, this exoskeleton of the digital agent. transcript.sec: Demo: Building a Robot with Agents

turns.en: Meet MicroDuck, Hugging Face's robot. Let's teach it to see and walk with NVIDIA RTX Spark. I use Hermes as my agent harness. NeMo Tron and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as my models, and CUDA-X accelerated tools, FreeCAD, Blender, and Isaac Sim, Newton physics engine, and Isaac Lab. I'll run everything on my RTX Spark, except when I need to burst larger workloads to cloud. First, I describe the course and what my Micro Duck needs to learn. On RTX Spark, Hermes and NeMo Tron plan the course, listing every object required. Astra takes it from there, using FreeCAD to model 3D objects, Blender to apply materials, and Omniverse Sim Ready libraries to add physical properties. In Isaac Sim, Astra composes the scene. Astra rigs Micro Duck's joints, actuators, and links, and simulates how Micro Duck moves with Newton physics engine. Now, training begins. In the cloud, thousands of Micro Ducks train in parallel in Isaac Lab. Every fall, a lesson, improving the policy every time. Omniverse libraries simulate Micro Duck's cameras, teaching it to see. With perception and physics working together, my Micro Duck can avoid obstacles, navigate tight spaces, and adapt to its surroundings. I download the policy to RTX Spark, and use NeMo Tron and Isaac Sim to evaluate my Micro Duck with multi-robot orchestration. I deploy the validated policy to the real duck and he's on his way. NVIDIA RTX Spark, build and run AI agents and their accelerated tools right on your laptop.
